jinhsi.name: Jinhsi
jinhsi.title: Magistrate
jinhsi.backstory: The dragon-blooded Magistrate of a great walled city in the sea-trade cities of the far east coast, Jinhsi carries the weight of her people with perfect composure. She came west on a diplomatic visit and keeps finding reasons not to leave.

sig_jinhsi.label: Magistrate's robes
sig_jinhsi.prompt: high-collared narrow black halter top trimmed in gold, white teal sashes, high waisted dark shorts, and sleek thigh-high white boots

sp_jinhsi.label: Peach Blossom
sp_jinhsi.prompt: a flowing white, pink and crimson ceremonial dress patterned with blooming peach blossoms and sheer pink silk ribbons

hsin.note: Two guardians of the same coast.

fem_rover.note: The trusted Arbiter who stood beside Jinzhou in its darkest hour.

unique.name: Magistrate's Bearing
unique.desc: A magistrate's authority impresses nobles and settles the house.

carlotta.name: Carlotta Montelli
carlotta.backstory: The second daughter of a powerful merchant family from the sea-trade cities of the far east coast, Carlotta collects art, settles disputes with an ornate pistol, and treats Sam's business as an investment she is still evaluating.

design.accessories: a thin magenta headband and hair ribbons

sig_carlotta.label: Montelli finery
sig_carlotta.prompt: a short, white, sleeveless flowing dress with a high neckline, a vibrant magenta-colored cape with teal lining, black gloves, and thigh-high black boots with magenta stockings

fem_rover.note: Her favorite dancing partner and most reliable collaborator.

unique.name: Merchant's Pistol
unique.desc: A shrewd negotiator with a decorative but credible deterrent.

hsin.name: Hsin
hsin.backstory: The Heart Moon Fox, an ancient guardian spirit of a mountain city in the sea-trade cities of the far east coast, taking a mortal-sized shape for a while. Hsin dances under moonlight and answers questions with riddles.

design.features: white fox ears, a fluffy white fox tail, heavy red eyeshadow and ornate red tattoos on her hands and thighs

sig_hsin.label: Moon guardian robes
sig_hsin.prompt: low cut black bodice with white and red flowing robes with detached sleeves

jinhsi.note: Two guardians of the same coast.

suoming.note: Her cute minister whom she trusts a great deal.

unique.name: Moonlit Riddles
unique.desc: She dances under moonlight and enchants the wealthy.

cartethyia.name: Cartethyia
cartethyia.backstory: A blessed maiden of the tide from the island city-states of Rinascita, Cartethyia spent centuries crowned in a pale blue laurel halo as the voice that calms storms. She sings in a clear, unhurried voice, carries a slender rapier she rarely draws, and is quietly overwhelmed by a city that never stops talking. She shares a name and an old, difficult history with the horned sovereign who sometimes walks beside her.

design.features: pointed elf ears and a pale blue laurel halo

sig_cartethyia.label: Tide-singer's gown
sig_cartethyia.prompt: short white vestments over a short, black dress, completely open chest, with blue gradient fabric flowing behind her

fleurdelys.note: Two names, one history, and very little to say to each other so far.

fem_rover.note: The knight who freed her from the inverted tower.

unique.name: Storm-Stilling Song
unique.desc: Her singing soothes a room, steadying moods and lifting her dancing.

fleurdelys.name: Fleurdelys
fleurdelys.backstory: A horned sovereign from the storm-wracked spires of Rinascita, Fleurdelys is what remains when a blessed maiden grows tall enough to defy a false god with blade in hand. She is regal, impatient, and aware that every room she enters is a battlefield with better decorations. She is not fond of the smaller tide-singer who shares her past; she is very fond of a spirited argument and a strong drink.

design.hairStyle: long flowing with a high crown braid
design.hairColor: blonde with a subtle soft-blue gradient
design.features: long pointed elf ears, a long golden horn and a crystal-blue crown of thorns

sig_fleurdelys.label: Martyr's gown
sig_fleurdelys.prompt: short white vestments over a very short black dress, completely open chest, with blue fabric flowing behind her

cartethyia.note: Two names, one history, and very little to say to each other so far.

fem_rover.note: The only opponent who ever bested her blade cleanly.

unique.name: Sovereign's Blade
unique.desc: A commanding presence that cows rowdy clients and gives her real security muscle.

buling.name: Buling
buling.backstory: A Black Shores consultant and self-proclaimed "Spiritchaser Taoist" from the sea-trade cities of the far east coast, Buling is known for fortune-telling, feng shui and selling talismans on her travels. She wandered into the Lantern, announced that its feng shui was a disaster, and has been rearranging the furniture uninvited ever since.

design.hairStyle: shoulder-length with a short side ponytail tied with black ribbons
design.accessories: large black headphones with gold trim

sig_buling.label: Spiritchaser's dress
sig_buling.prompt: a very short white dress with an open ornate black vest and detached sleeves

suoming.note: Buling pokes the auditor; the auditor pretends not to mind.

unique.name: Feng Shui Fortune
unique.desc: Her talismans and rearranged furniture make the house feel luckier, drawing guests in.

suoming.name: Suoming
suoming.backstory: Born in Huating, Mengzhou, in the sea-trade cities of the far east coast, Suoming founded the Ten Seals Covenant as its Seal Master to free her homeland from the Evil Miasma. A seal-binding keeps her from aging, which is how she is two centuries old and still looks about twenty-five. Later, by the Sentinel's decree, she served as Intendant of the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs, watching over all of Mengzhou. Now visiting the west, she inspects Sam's house like a ministry audit, clipboard-faced and unimpressed.

design.accessories: large gold bells in her hair

sig_suoming.label: Seal Master's dress
sig_suoming.prompt: a very short little black dress with an open ornate black cape

buling.note: The auditor's one persistent finding: Buling.

hsin.note: The sentinel she has sworn to watch over.

unique.name: Seal Master
unique.desc: Centuries of command keep the house orderly and its staff in line.

iuno.name: Iuno
iuno.title: Priestess
iuno.backstory: A prodigy priestess of Septimont who reads fate in the shifting phases of the moon, Iuno grew tired of senators demanding safe prophecies and set out across the sea. She carries a crescent moonbow, dresses in white-and-gold temple silk, and insists she foresaw every decision Sam makes three nights ago.

design.hairStyle: floor-length twin tails with side bangs
design.hairColor: midnight blue fading to translucent sky-blue tips
design.accessories: a golden winged laurel-and-crescent hair crown and gold armlets

sig_iuno.label: Moon Priestess dress
sig_iuno.prompt: an asymmetrical white-and-gold classical priestess dress with a golden bandeau chest piece exposing her midriff, sheer blue-tinted drapes and golden sandals with leg wrappings

augusta.note: Sun and moon of Septimont—Augusta's arena triumphs and Iuno's prophecies always seem to align.

unique.name: Lunar Prophecy
unique.desc: Her moon-sight anticipates noble whims and turns every evening in her company into destiny.

augusta.name: Augusta
augusta.title: Ephor
augusta.backstory: The undefeated gladiator champion and reigning Ephor of Septimont, Augusta forged her own legend in the sun-drenched colosseum with an oversized broadblade and unyielding willpower. Visiting Hollowmere between campaigns, she treats the Lantern's security like an honor guard and respects only those who meet her blazing gaze without flinching.

design.eyes: crimson red with golden-white pupil rings
design.accessories: a golden sunburst laurel crown and eight-pointed gold star earrings

sig_augusta.label: Ephor's panoply
sig_augusta.prompt: a sleeveless high-necked white tunic under an ornate golden chestplate, bronze shoulder pauldrons, a crimson-and-gold split gladiator skirt with leather pteruges over high-cut black shorts and armored greaves

iuno.note: Septimont's Moon Priestess—the only woman whose counsel Augusta never ignores.

unique.name: Undefeated Sun
unique.desc: The blazing charisma and arena might of Septimont's Ephor keep the house secure and its guests in awe.

aemeath.name: Aemeath
aemeath.backstory: Once a Synchronist cadet of the Roya Tribe's Startorch Academy, Aemeath now drifts between worlds as a radiant digital spirit who leaves trails of starlight wherever she hums. She materialized in the Lantern's stage lights one evening, delighted to find an audience that can actually see and touch her.

design.hairColor: vibrant rose-pink fading to warm blonde tips
design.skin: luminous fair skin with a faint starlight digital shimmer
design.features: faint glowing pink starlight motes drifting near her shoulders

sig_aemeath.label: Synchronist suit
sig_aemeath.prompt: a sleek white-and-charcoal futuristic Synchronist dress with glowing rose-pink and cyan circuit accents, detached sleeves and thigh straps

fem_rover.note: Her cherished anchor to the waking world.

unique.name: Starlight Resonance
unique.desc: Her weightless, starlit songs lift the whole house's spirits and draw crowds from down the street.

camellya.name: Camellya
camellya.backstory: A Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores who lives entirely by instinct and thrill, Camellya follows promising 'seeds' across continents just to watch them blossom. She wandered into Hollowmere with crimson vines curling from her fingertips and decided Sam was the most fascinating flower in the garden.

design.hairStyle: asymmetrical twin tails, one short and one long
design.hairColor: pure white with crimson-red inner streaks and tips
design.features: a glowing red Tacet Mark on her upper chest and red camellia blossoms in her hair

sig_camellya.label: Bloom Bearer dress
sig_camellya.prompt: a plunging backless white-and-black gothic leotard dress with crimson camellia flower ornaments, vine-like dark straps and sheer black thigh-high stockings

fem_rover.note: Her favorite 'seed' across every lifetime—she still watches Rover like a cat watching a bird.

unique.name: Crimson Blossom
unique.desc: She throws herself into every encounter with reckless, intoxicating intensity.

fem_rover.name: Rover
fem_rover.title: Arbiter
fem_rover.backstory: An awakened traveler with golden eyes and no memory of where her long journey began, Rover has crossed seas, quieted lament-torn cities, and collected half the east coast's heroines as devoted companions. In Hollowmere she finally sets her sword down for a season, lending Sam her steady blade and quiet magnetism.

design.hairStyle: medium-length with a half-up ponytail and a longer braided lock at the back
design.hairColor: jet black with pale silver-white inner streaks
design.features: a glowing Tacet Mark on the back of her right hand
design.accessories: a white feather hair ornament pinned at her temple

sig_fem_rover.label: Arbiter's attire
sig_fem_rover.prompt: a sleeveless black-and-white asymmetrical halter dress with a plunged keyhole cutout, a cropped dark jacket panel over her shoulders, detached black sleeves and thigh-high dark boots

jinhsi.note: Jinzhou's Magistrate, whose trust she earned in battle.

carlotta.note: Her partner in Rinascita's high society and intrigues.

cartethyia.note: A bond forged atop the inverted tower.

camellya.note: Camellya never lets her wander far out of sight.

unique.name: Harmonic Arbiter
unique.desc: People naturally gravitate to her calm leadership, boosting security and house harmony alike.
